parameters.content:
## HUNTER v0.4 — Core Hunt Upgrade

Production: hourly + manual + POST /webhook/hunter/scan → 3 RSS sources → merge → score/filter.

App status: GET /webhook/hunter/status.

Changes: source trust separated from Hunter Score; risk flags; shortened-link penalty; 24h re-check for non-qualified items; 30d dedupe for qualified items; on-demand scan endpoint.

Safety: watch-only public wallet address only; no seed/private keys; no signing; no trading; no transfers.

IMPORTANT: deactivate the older HUNTER workflow before publishing because /hunter/status uses the same production path.
